paragraphs: Modiv Industrial, Inc. ("Modiv") is an internally-managed Maryland corporation that acquires, owns and manages a portfolio of single-tenant net-lease properties throughout the United States, with a focus on critical industrial manufacturing properties with long-term leases to tenants that fuel the national economy and strengthen the nation's supply chains. Modiv also owns three non-core, legacy retail and office real estate properties, and is gradually reducing its non-core exposure, subject to market conditions, as it furthers its focus as a pure-play industrial manufacturing real estate investment trust ("REIT"). Modiv seeks to provide investors access to MOnthly DIVidends through a durable portfolio of real estate investments designed to generate both current income and long-term growth. Modiv has operated as a REIT for U.S. federal income tax purposes beginning with the year ended December 31, 2016.

As used herein, the terms "Modiv," the "Company," "we," "our" and "us" refer to Modiv Industrial, Inc. and, as required by context, Modiv Operating Partnership, LP, a Delaware limited partnership (our "Operating Partnership" or "Modiv OP").

Our Class C common stock, $0.001 par value per share (the "Class C Common Stock"), is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (the "NYSE") under the symbol "MDV." Our 7.375% Series A Cumulative Redeemable Perpetual Preferred Stock, $0.001 par value per share (the "Series A Preferred Stock"), also is listed on the NYSE under the symbol "MDV.PA."

Details of our diversified portfolio of 42 operating properties, including one property held for sale and an approximate 72.7% tenant-in-common interest in a Santa Clara, California industrial property (the "TIC Interest") as of December 31, 2025 are as follows:

• Annual base rent ("ABR") aggregating $39.1 million, which is calculated based on the next 12 months of contractual monthly base rent as of December 31, 2025 (on a pro forma basis reflecting our January 2026 acquisition of the remaining 27.3% TIC interest owned by third parties, ABR was $39.8 million based on the next 12 months of contractual monthly base rent as of December 31, 2025);

•39 industrial properties, which represent approximately 82% of the portfolio (expressed as a percentage of ABR), including the TIC Interest and one property held for sale, and three non-core properties which represent approximately 18% of the portfolio by ABR;
•28% of the portfolio by ABR is leased by investment grade tenants;
•Weighted average remaining lease term ("WALT"), excluding tenants' rights to extend leases, of approximately 14.0 years as of December 31, 2025;
•Occupancy rate of 98% based on square footage; • Located in 14 states; • Leased to 27 different commercial tenants doing business in 12 separate industries;
• Approximately 4.4 million square feet of aggregate leasable space, including the TIC Interest;

• An average leasable space per property of approximately 104,000 square feet (approximately 107,000 square feet per industrial property and approximately 68,000 square feet per non-core property); and

• Outstanding mortgage notes payable balance of $12.1 million for one consolidated property, $12.1 million for the unconsolidated property that became wholly-owned in January 2026 and a credit facility term loan balance of $250.0 million.

During the year ended December 31, 2025, we acquired an industrial manufacturing property located in Florida. We also sold two properties (a vacant office property in Washington and an industrial property in New York). See Notes 3 and 13 to our accompanying consolidated financial statements included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K for further details of our acquisitions and dispositions. Subsequent to December 31, 2025, we acquired the 27.3% remaining TIC interest for $9.6 million, giving us 100% ownership of the property.

To date, we have invested primarily in single-tenant, income-producing properties, leased to creditworthy tenants under long-term net leases. Although we are not limited as to the form our investments may take, our investments in real estate will primarily constitute acquiring fee title or interests in entities that own and operate real estate. We own and will make acquisitions of our real estate investments through special purpose limited liability companies which are wholly-owned subsidiaries of our Operating Partnership or indirectly through limited liability companies or limited partnerships, including through other REITs, or through investments in joint ventures, partnerships, tenants-in-common, co-tenancies or other co-ownership arrangements with

headings: Risks Related to an Investment in Our Class C Common Stock

Our listing on the NYSE does not guarantee an active and liquid market for our Class C Common Stock, and the market price and trading volume of the shares of our Class C Common Stock may fluctuate significantly.
The future issuance or sale of additional shares of our Class C Common Stock could adversely affect the trading price of our Class C Common Stock.
Our distributions to stockholders may change, which could adversely affect the market price of our Class C Common Stock.
Increases in market interest rates may result in a decrease in the market price of our Class C Common Stock.
We face significant competition for real estate investment opportunities, which may limit our ability to acquire suitable investments and achieve our investment objectives or pay distributions.

Investments in real estate are illiquid, and it may not be possible to dispose of assets in a timely manner or on favorable terms, which could adversely affect our financial condition, operating results and cash flows.
Our real estate properties and related intangible assets may be subject to impairment charges.
We are subject to risks related to tenant concentration, and an adverse development with respect to a large tenant could materially and adversely affect us.
We may change our targeted investments or investment strategy.
We have incurred losses in the past and we may experience additional losses in the future.
If we are unable to obtain funding for future capital needs, cash distributions to our stockholders and the value of our investments could decline.
Risks Related to Our Corporate Structure
Our charter and bylaws contain provisions that may delay, defer or prevent an acquisition of our Class C Common Stock or a change in control.
Our rights and the rights of our stockholders to take action against our directors and officers are limited.
Certain provisions of Maryland law may limit the ability of a third-party to acquire control of us.
The change of control conversion and redemption features of the Series A Preferred Stock may make it more difficult for a party to acquire us or discourage a party from seeking to acquire us.
Certain provisions in our Operating Partnership Agreement may delay, make more difficult, or prevent unsolicited acquisitions of us.
General Risks Related to Investments in Real Estate
Economic, market and regulatory changes that impact the real estate market generally may decrease the value of our investments and weaken our operating results.
We are subject to risks from natural disasters, such as hurricanes, tornadoes and flooding, and changes in weather patterns.
We intend to purchase properties with (or enter into, as necessary) long-term leases with tenants, which may not result in fair market rental rates over time.
Costs imposed pursuant to laws and governmental regulations may reduce our net income and our cash available for distribution to our stockholders.
We are subject to risks relating to litigation and regulatory liability.
Inflation and rising interest rates may adversely affect our financial condition and results of operations or result in a decrease in the market price of our Class C Common Stock.

paragraphs: Our Class C Common Stock began trading on the NYSE in 2022, and we can provide no assurance an active and liquid trading market for the shares of our Class C Common Stock will be sustained. The market price and liquidity of our Class C Common Stock may be adversely affected by the absence of an active trading market. The market price for the shares of our Class C Common Stock may not equal or may exceed the price our stockholders pay for their shares.
The trading price for our Class C Common Stock may be influenced by many factors, including:

• general financial and economic market conditions and, in particular, developments related to market conditions for REITs and other real estate-related companies including the potential impact of inflation;
• low trading volume in our Class C Common Stock, which makes it difficult to attract institutional investors;
• our operating results and financial condition, including actual or anticipated quarterly fluctuations therein;

• our ability to grow through property acquisitions or real estate-related investments, the terms and pace of any acquisitions we may make and the availability and terms of financing for those acquisitions;

paragraphs: Management's discussion and analysis of financial condition and results of operations are based upon our accompanying audited consolidated financial statements, which have been prepared in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles in the United States of America ("GAAP"). The preparation of these financial statements requires our management to make estimates and assumptions that affect the reported amounts of assets, liabilities, revenues and expenses, and related disclosure of contingent assets and liabilities. On a regular basis, we evaluate these estimates. These estimates are based on management's historical industry experience and on various other assumptions that are believed to be reasonable under the circumstances. Actual results may differ from these estimates.

Although we are not limited as to the form our investments may take, our investments in real estate will generally constitute acquiring fee title or interests in entities that own and operate real estate. We will make substantially all acquisitions of our real estate investments directly through the Operating Partnership or indirectly through limited liability companies or limited partnerships, including through other REITs, or through investments in joint ventures, partnerships, tenants-in-common, co-tenancies or other co-ownership arrangements with other owners of properties. We are the sole general partner of, and owned an approximate 81% interest in the Operating Partnership as of both December 31, 2025 and March 20, 2026. The Operating Partnership's limited partnership interests are further described in Note 11 to our accompanying consolidated financial statements included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. We report with the SEC as a smaller reporting company under Rule 12b-2 of the Exchange Act.
•to provide attractive growth in AFFO (as defined below) and sustainable cash distributions;
•to realize appreciation from proactive investment selection and management; •to provide future opportunities for growth and value creation; and
•to provide an investment alternative for stockholders seeking to allocate a portion of their long-term investment portfolios to industrial manufacturing real estate.

We expect the trend of onshoring manufacturing to accelerate and we will continue to focus future acquisitions on industrial manufacturing properties, subject to market conditions and the availability of prices that we consider attractive. We can provide no assurance that we will achieve our investment objectives. See the Part I, Item 1A. Risk Factors section of this Annual Report on Form 10-K for additional information.

There are continuing significant uncertainties in the market in which we operate related to inflation and interest rates, tariffs, supply chain disruptions and negative impacts associated with foreign policy actions implemented by the United States. Volatility in stock and bond markets, and particularly yields on U.S. Treasury securities, may negatively impact our operating results, liquidity and sources of borrowings.

We, our tenants and operating partners are impacted by inflation and interest rates. While the rate of inflation has declined from historic highs, inflation remains elevated and there is continued uncertainty over the future rate of inflation and interest rates. While the Federal Reserve reduced rates in September, October and December 2025, the Federal Reserve may refrain from reducing interest rates further to try to rein in inflation, which could lead to a recession, and would negatively impact our future operating results due to higher borrowing costs. In addition, sustained elevated inflation rates may negatively impact our longer term leases if contractual rent increases are not sufficient to keep up with market leases.

In January 2026, we entered into three new swap agreements, effective December 31, 2025, for $83.3 million each, for an aggregate of $250.0 million, corresponding to the Term Loan (as defined below), which will fix the Secured Overnight Financing Rate ("SOFR") for the year ending December 31, 2026 to 2.45%, resulting in a fixed rate of 4.15% based on our leverage ratio of 45.1% as of December 31, 2025. We paid aggregate premiums of $2.7 million, including accrued interest receivable of $0.1 million, to buy down the fixed rate below the prevailing market rate. The buydown premium is a derivative that will be recorded as an asset on our balance sheet as of January 31, 2026 and amortized over the 12 months ending December 31, 2026, increasing interest expense by approximately $0.6 million per quarter. We designated these pay-fixed, receive-floating interest rate swaps as cash flow hedges, which are expected to be effective through December 31, 2026. The derivatives will be marked to fair value each reporting period with any change in fair value recorded through accumulated other comprehensive income as long as the derivatives are deemed effective.

Possible future declines in rental rates and expectations of future rental concessions, including free rent to renew tenants early, to retain tenants who are up for renewal or to attract new tenants, may result in decreases in cash flows . There are no leases scheduled to expire within the next 12 months. We have one lease scheduled to expire in 2027: our property in Charlotte, North Carolina leased to Husqvarna that expires on June 30, 2027.

Potential future declines in economic conditions could negatively impact commercial real estate fundamentals and result in lower occupancy and rental rates and cause declining values in our real estate portfolio, which could have the following negative effects on us: the values of our investments in commercial properties could decrease below the amounts paid for such investments; and/or revenues from our properties could decrease due to fewer tenants and/or lower rental rates, making it more difficult for us to make distributions or meet our debt service obligations. We obtained two lease extensions during 2025, with Fujifilm Dimatix, Inc. extending its lease for ten years from March 17, 2026 to March 16, 2036, and Northrop Grumman Systems Corporation extending its lease for five years from June 1, 2026 to May 31, 2031; however, changing circumstances may make future lease extensions more difficult.

The debt market remains sensitive to the macro environment, such as inflation, Federal Reserve policy, the impacts of increases in tariffs by the U.S. and other countries, market sentiment and regulatory factors affecting the banking and commercial mortgage-backed securities industries. Our Credit Facility (as defined below) includes floating interest rates based on SOFR and our leverage ratio as described below. We entered into new swaps for 2026 that fix the rate of our Term Loan for one year. Our mortgages with fixed rates, including the mortgage on the Santa Clara, California property leased to Fujifilm Dimatix, Inc., mature after September 2027. As a result of the interest rate swap agreements entered into for the year ending December 31, 2026, 100% of our indebtedness has a weighted average fixed interest rate of 4.14% as long as our leverage ratio is less than 50%.

Any future uncertainties in the capital markets may cause difficulty in refinancing debt obligations prior to maturity at terms as favorable as the terms of existing indebtedness. If we are not able to refinance our indebtedness on attractive terms, or at all, at the various maturity dates, we may be forced to dispose of some of our assets. Market conditions can change quickly, potentially negatively impacting the value of real estate investments.

Generally, our cash requirements for property acquisitions, debt payments and refinancings, capital expenditures and other investments will be funded by bank borrowings through our Credit Facility (as defined below), mortgage indebtedness on our properties, real estate property sales, internally generated funds or offerings of shares of our Class C Common Stock.

paragraphs: Modiv Industrial, Inc. ("Modiv") 為一間 internally-managed 馬裏蘭州公司，專門取得、擁有並管理位於美國全境的單租戶淨租賃不動產組合，重點為對國家經濟至關重要的工業製造不動產，並與租戶簽訂長期租約，以強化國家的供應鏈。Modiv 還擁有三處非核心的零售與辦公室不動產，並正在根據市場情況逐漸減少非核心資產的敞口，以強化其作為純粹工業製造不動產投資信託 ("REIT") 的定位。Modiv 希望透過一個能產生現金收入與長期成長的不動產投資組合，為投資人提供每月股息 (MOnthly DIVidends)。Modiv 自 2016 年 12 月 31 日結業年度起，已根據美國聯邦所得稅法規作為 REIT 運作。
herein 所稱 "Modiv"、"本公司"、"我們"、"我們的" 以及 "我們"，均指 Modiv Industrial, Inc.，並根據語境需要，亦包括 Modiv Operating Partnership, LP，一間德克薩斯州有限責任合夥企業 (我們的 "營運合夥企業" 或 "Modiv OP")。
我們的 Class C 普通股，每股面值 $0.001 ("Class C 普通股")，於紐約證券交易所 ("NYSE") 以符號 "MDV" 認購。我們的 7.375% 系列 A 累積可贖回永續優先股，每股面值 $0.001 ("系列 A 優先股")，亦於紐約證券交易所以符號 "MDV.PA" 認購。
我們 diversified 的不動產組合包含 42 間營運中的不動產，包括一處待售不動產，以及於 2025 年 12 月 31 日持有約 72.7% 的聖克拉拉，加州工業不動產的共同租賃權益 ("TIC 權益")，詳細資訊如下：
• 年度基本租金 ("ABR") 約為 39.1 百萬美元，計算基準為 2025 年 12 月 31 日的下 12 個月合約月基本租金 (以 2026 年 1 月取得剩餘 27.3% TIC 權益的 pro forma 基準計算，ABR 約為 39.8 百萬美元，計算基準為 2025 年 12 月 31 日的下 12 個月合約月基本租金)；
• 39 間工業不動產，約佔組合的 82% (以 ABR 表示百分比)，包括 TIC 權益與一處待售不動產，以及三處非核心不動產，約佔組合的 18% (以 ABR 表示百分比)；
• 約 28% 的組合 (以 ABR 表示) 由投資等級租戶租賃；
• 排除租戶延長租約權利的加權平均剩餘租賃期間 ("WALT")，約為 14.0 年，於 2025 年 12 月 31 日為準；
• 佔用率為 98% 係以平方英呎計算；• 位於 14 個州；• 租賃給 27 家不同商業租戶，這些租戶從事 12 種不同的產業；
• 累計可出租空間約為 4.4 百萬平方英呎，包括 TIC 權益；
• 每個物業平均可出租空間約為 104,000 平方英呎（約為 107,000 平方英呎每個工業物業及約為 68,000 平方英呎每個非核心物業）；以及
• 一個合併財務報表所包含的物業優質抵押貸款餘額為 12.1 百萬美元，一個成為 2026 年完全所有權的未合併財務報表所包含的物業優質抵押貸款餘額為 12.1 百萬美元，以及信貸融資.term loan 餘額為 250.0 百萬美元。

在 2025 年 12 月 31 日為止的會計年度內，我們取得一處位於佛羅裏達州的工業製造物業。我們也出售了兩處物業（一處位於華盛頓州的空置辦公室物業及一處位於紐約州的工業物業）。請參閱我們隨同本年度 10-K 報告所附的合併財務報表附註 3 與附註 13，以取得更多有關我們取得與處分物業的詳細資訊。2025 年 12 月 31 日之後，我們以 9.6 百萬美元取得剩餘 27.3% 的 TIC 權益，使我們取得該物業 100% 的所有權。

截至目前為止，我們主要投資於單一租戶、產生收入的物業，這些物業出租給信用良好的租戶，並以長期淨租賃方式出租。儘管我們對投資形式並無限制，但我們的房地產投資將主要為取得費用所有權或實體權益，這些實體擁有並營運房地產。我們擁有並將取得我們房地產投資的權益，透過特殊目的有限責任公司，這些公司為我們營運合夥企業的 wholly-owned 子公司，或間接透過有限責任公司或有限合夥企業，包括透過其他 REITs，或透過投資於合資企業、合夥企業、租戶共同擁有、共有人或其它共同擁有安排。

paragraphs: 本公司管理階層對於財務狀況及營運成果之討論與分析，係根據我們所附之經審計合併財務報表，該財務報表係依照美國通用會計原則（"GAAP"）編製。編製這些財務報表需要本公司管理階層做出影響資產、負債、收入及費用之數額，以及相關 contingent assets 和 liabilities 之揭露之估計與假設。本公司會定期評估這些估計。這些估計係根據管理階層之歷史產業經驗，以及在特定情況下認為合理之其他假設。實際結果可能與這些估計不同。

雖然本公司投資之形式並無限制，但本公司對不動產之投資，通常係取得 fee title 或擁有並營運不動產之實體之權益。本公司將透過 Operating Partnership 或透過有限責任公司或有限合夥企業，包括透過其他 REITs，或透過投資於合資企業、合夥企業、 tenants-in-common、 co-tenancies 或其他共有人之共 ownership 安排，取得 substantially all 之不動產投資。本公司為 Operating Partnership 之唯一 general partner，且截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日及 2026 年 3 月 20 日，本公司持有約 81% 之 Operating Partnership 權益。有關 Operating Partnership 之 limited partnership interests，請參閱本年度 10-K 報告所附之合併財務報表之附註 11。本公司根據證券交易法第 12b-2 條規則，向 SEC 報告為小型報表公司。
• 提供具吸引力之 AFFO（如下所定）成長與可持續之現金分紅；
• 實現來自積極投資選擇與管理之資產增值；• 提供未來成長與價值創造之機會；以及
•提供一種投資選擇，讓股東能將其長期投資組閤中的一部分配置至工業製造不動產。
我們預期製造業迴流美國的趨勢將加速，我們將持續將未來的收購重點放在工業製造不動產上，但需視市場狀況及我們認為具有吸引力的價格 availability 而定。我們無法保證我們能達成投資目標。請參閱本年度報告 10-K 表單的 Part I, Item 1A. 風險因素 部分以取得更多資訊。
我們所處市場存在持續的重大不確定性，與通貨膨脹、利率、關稅、供應鏈中斷以及美國政府所實施的外交政策行動帶來的負面影響有關。股票與債券市場的波動，尤其是美國國債收益率的波動，可能會對我們的營運成果、流動性及借款來源產生負面影響。

我們、我們的租戶及營運夥伴均受通貨膨脹與利率的影響。雖然通貨膨脹率已從歷史高點下降，但通貨膨脹仍處於高位，且未來通貨膨脹與利率的走勢仍存在持續的不確定性。雖然聯邦儲備委員會在 2025 年 9 月、10 月及 12 月減少了利率，但聯邦儲備委員會可能不會進一步減低利率以抑制通貨膨脹，這可能會導致經濟衰退，並因借款成本提高而對我們未來的營運成果產生負面影響。此外，持續的高通貨膨脹率可能會對我們的長期租賃合同產生負面影響，如果契約租金上漲幅度不足以追上市場租金水平的話。
未來租金率的可能下降，以及未來租金減讓的預期，包括為鼓勵租戶提前續約或吸引新租戶而提供的免租，可能會導致現金流量減少。在接下來的12個月內，沒有租賃合約將到期。本公司有一筆租賃合約將於2027年到期：位於北卡羅來納州夏洛特的不動產，出租給Husqvarna，到期日為2027年6月30日。

未來經濟條件的可能下降，可能會對商業不動產的基本面造成負面影響，導致佔用率和租金率下降，並使我們的不動產投資組合價值下降，這可能會對本公司產生以下負面影響：我們對商業不動產的投資價值可能低於購入價格；以及/或由於租戶減少和/或租金率下降，導致我們難以發放現金股息或履行債務償還義務。本公司於2025年獲得了兩筆租賃延長，其中Fujifilm Dimatix, Inc.將其租賃合約延長十年，自2026年3月17日起至2036年3月16日；Northrop Grumman Systems Corporation將其租賃合約延長五年，自2026年6月1日起至2031年5月31日；然而，變動的情況可能使未來的租賃延長變得更加困難。

債券市場仍然對總體經濟環境敏感，例如通貨膨脹、美國聯邦儲備委員會政策、美國及其他國家提高關稅的影響、市場情緒以及影響銀行業和商業抵押貸款支持證券產業的監管因素。我們的信貸融資（如下文所定義）包含根據SOFR和我們的負債比率（如下文所定義）計算的浮動利率。我們為2026年簽訂了新的交換協議，以固定我們的貸款利率一年。我們的固定利率抵押貸款，包括出租給Fujifilm Dimatix, Inc.的加州聖克拉拉不動產抵押貸款，將在2027年9月後到期。根據為2026年12月31日結算年度簽訂的利率交換協議，只要我們的負債比率低於50%，我們的全部債務將具有4.14%的加權平均固定利率。
未來資本市場的任何不確定性可能會導致在債務到期前難以以與現有債務條款一樣有利的條件重新融資債務義務。如果我們無法在各個到期日以有利的條件重新融資債務，或完全無法重新融資，我們可能被迫出售部分資產。市場條件可能迅速變化，這可能會對不動產投資的價值產生負面影響。
通常，我們在不動產購置、債務償還及重新融資、資本支出及其他投資方面的現金需求，將由我們的信貸融資（如下文所定義）的銀行貸款、我們不動產的抵押貸款債務、不動產銷售、內部產生的資金或發行我們Class C普通股來資金。

headings: 與投資本公司普通股 C 類相關的風險
本公司於紐約證券交易所上市並不能保證本公司普通股 C 類有活躍且流動的交易市場，且本公司普通股 C 類的市場價格及交易量可能大幅波動。
本公司未來發行或出售額外的普通股 C 類，可能對本公司普通股 C 類的交易價格產生不利影響。
本公司對股東的分派可能有所變動，這可能對本公司普通股 C 類的市場價格產生不利影響。
市場利率上升可能導致本公司普通股 C 類的市場價格下降。
與本公司業務相關的風險
本公司在不動產投資機會方面面臨重大競爭，這可能限制本公司取得合適投資並實現投資目標或支付分派的能力。
不動產投資屬流動性差的資產，且可能無法在合適的條件下或及時處理資產，這可能對本公司財務狀況、營運結果及現金流產生不利影響。
本公司之不動產及相關無形資產可能需提列減損費用。
本公司面臨租戶集中之風險，且對大型租戶之不利發展可能重大且不利地影響本公司。
本公司可能改變目標投資或投資策略。
本公司過去曾產生虧損，未來亦可能產生額外虧損。
若本公司無法取得未來資金以應付資本需求，則對股東之現金分紅及投資價值可能下降。
與本公司公司結構相關之風險
本公司章程及章程規則包含可能延宕、延後或防止本公司普通股 Class C 收購或控制權變更之條款。
本公司及股東對董事及高階主管之權利受到限制。
馬裏蘭州某些法律條文可能限制第三方取得本公司控制權的能力。
Series A 優先股的控制權轉換及贖回條款可能使某一方取得本公司變得更加困難，或抑制某一方取得本公司之意圖。
我們的經營合夥協議中某些條款可能延宕、使取得本公司變得更加困難，或阻止未經邀請的收購交易。
投資不動產的總體風險
影響不動產市場的經濟、市場及法規變動，可能降低我們投資的價值，並削弱我們的營運成果。
我們面臨天然災害（如颶風、龍捲風及水災）及氣候模式變動的風險。
我們有意購買具有（或如需要，與租客簽訂）長期租賃契約的不動產，這些租賃契約可能在長遠時間內無法提供公平市場租金。
根據法律及政府法規所課徵的費用，可能降低我們的淨收入，以及我們可供分配給股東的現金。
本公司面臨與訴訟及監管責任相關之風險。
通貨膨脹及利率上漲可能不利於本公司之財務狀況及營運結果，或導致本公司 Class C 普通股之市場價格下降。
與單租戶不動產投資相關之風險
paragraphs: 本公司 Class C 普通股自 2022 年起在紐約證券交易所（NYSE）開始交易，本公司無法保證本公司 Class C 普通股將持續擁有活躍且流動性高的交易市場。本公司 Class C 普通股的市場價格與流動性可能因缺乏活躍交易市場而受到不利影響。本公司 Class C 普通股的市場價格可能與本公司股東購入股份時所支付的價格不同，甚至可能高於該價格。
本公司 Class C 普通股的交易價格可能受多種因素影響，包括：
• 總體經濟與金融市場的一般狀況，特別是與 REITs 及其他房地產相關公司市場條件的發展，包括通貨膨脹可能產生的影響；
• 本公司 Class C 普通股的交易量偏低，使吸引機構投資人變得困難；
• 本公司營運成果與財務狀況，包括實際或預期的季度變動情況；
• 本公司透過不動產取得或房地產相關投資來實現成長的能力，以及任何可能進行的取得交易的條款與速度，以及這些取得交易的融資可得性與條款；
